text: I've been waiting over 40 minutes for someone to get back to me. My granddaughter is 9 and her temperature is 39.7. She's got a rash on her tummy. I did the glass test like you're supposed to and it goes pale when you press, so I know about that one. Her eczema is also flaring up badly, dry itchy patches on her arms and behind her knees, she won't stop scratching. No fits, no shaking or jerking, nothing like that. I'd just like some advice on what to do tonight please, if anyone's actually there.
